Union Minister Giriraj Singh Receives Death Threat Via Letter

Union Minister Giriraj Singh has received a death threat through an anonymous letter sent to his ministry. The letter was delivered to his ministerial office. Following the threat, a case has been registered by the Begusarai police, who have initiated an investigation into the matter.
